title: Money and transportation fees
content: About a week or so ago I had dreams where i had to pay for a bus and subway fee to get around my connecting dream world in order to get around and I kept forgetting to upload money on my bus card. So my card kept getting lower and lower until my most recent dream I said to myself that I had didn’t have anymore money to put on my card then I had to scavenge around to look for money. I then sort of stopped having transportation dreams as far as I’m aware of. Anyone else dream of paying for transportation fees? (I’m also starting to forget my dreams slowly so I might take some magnesium to help me sleep better as well and see if that works. I’ve been craving chocolate so that might be a sign I’m low too)
